svg.title: Threshold sensitivity of physical area and equivalent diameter
svg.desc: The same image and spatial metadata are used for every threshold. The dashed reference in the left panel is the original synthetic generator mask area, not an expert annotation. The diameter is that of a circle with equal area, not a measured anatomical diameter. No probability distribution over thresholds is assumed.
